reason: The commit only removes fuzz-build abort behavior for invalid UTF-8 and XML_ERR_ARGUMENT. It introduces no new entry point, API protocol, state, configuration, input semantics, or attack surface. H0 already supplies arbitrary bytes and parser options, and its HTML target invokes htmlDocContentDumpOutput, exercising serialization behavior. The changes therefore relax error handling without creating or materially aggravating a harness gap.
evidence: entities.c removes the FUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION fprintf/abort block from xmlEncodeEntitiesInternal while preserving replacement with 0xFFFD.
xmlsave.c removes equivalent invalid-UTF-8 abort blocks from xmlEscapeEntities and xmlBufAttrSerializeTxtContent while preserving their existing replacement-character handling.
error.c narrows the fuzz-only abort condition in xmlVRaiseError from XML_ERR_INTERNAL_ERROR or XML_ERR_ARGUMENT to XML_ERR_INTERNAL_ERROR only.
fuzz/html.c LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput passes arbitrary docBuffer bytes and fuzz-derived opts to htmlCtxtReadMemory and invokes htmlDocContentDumpOutput on produced documents.
No changed function adds a callable interface, required setup state, configuration mode, or new input field that H0 cannot control.
recommended_action: No harness maintenance is needed for this commit.
